value.rationale: The imaginary Berezin strip half-width is a natural geometric invariant because the ranges are conjugate symmetric and lie in the right half-plane. It distinguishes |a| strictly even though the ordinary Berezin number is identically one, supplies the unique norming-radius and exact finite angular multiplicity, and quantifies loss of attainment in the compact-to-isometric limit through a sharp square-root law and all boundary-extremizing sequences. This provides a natural inverse and critical-geometry classification, not an arbitrary finite calculation.
